title: Authentication
text: Three pieces, app — aurora_app() needs auth knowledge: 1. scheme (helper). helpers/auth_setup.R defines scheme user lookup: 2. gate (header route). routers/guard.R runs every /api/* handler — request body even received — rejecting anyone without valid token clean 401: 3. Public login/logout (/api, gate ignores ).
code: auth <- aurora_auth_jwt(secret = Sys.getenv("AURORA_JWT_SECRET", "dev-only")) secure_cookies <- identical(Sys.getenv("AURORA_ENV"), "prod") find_user <- function(name) ...   # your DB / store; passwords hashed with sodium #* @any /api/* #* @header function(request) {   aurora_jwt_guard(auth, request)   # 401 via reqres::abort_unauthorized() if invalid   plumber2::Next                    # otherwise continue the chain } #* @post /auth/login #* @parser json #* @serializer json function(request, response, body = NULL) {   u <- find_user(body$user)   if (is.null(u) || !sodium::password_verify(u$hash, body$pass %||% "")) {     response$status <- 401L     return(list(error = "Usuario ou senha invalidos."))   }   token <- aurora_jwt_token(auth, list(user = u$name))   aurora_set_auth_cookie(auth, response, token, secure = secure_cookies)   list(user = u$name) }  #* @post /auth/logout #* @serializer json function(response) {   aurora_clear_auth_cookie(auth, response, secure = secure_cookies)   list(status = "ok") }

title: Authentication
text: cookie HttpOnly, JavaScript never touches token. app.js simply probes GET /api/load (reveal app success), posts /auth/login / /auth/logout, shows login overlay whenever /api call returns 401 via runtime’s aurora.onUnauthorized hook.

title: Authentication
text: plumber2’s native api_auth_guard() + fireproof guards target upstream identity providers (OAuth/OIDC) shared static keys, require firesale datastore plugin, return 400/403. self-issued JWT-cookie session needs uniform 401 absent expired sessions (cookie expiry looks like “absent”) extra infrastructure — aurora uses @header guard + reqres::abort_unauthorized(), migration-endorsed replacement v1 filters.

title: Authentication
text: Set strong AURORA_JWT_SECRET (never commit ). Set AURORA_ENV=prod behind HTTPS Secure; SameSite=Strict cookies. Replace demo find_user() real, sodium-hashed user store.

title: Deploying aurora apps
text: static UI compiled build time shipped www/index.html; container serves rebuild , runtime image installs UI dependencies (bslib, transitively shiny). Build UI image: generated Dockerfile pulls R packages prebuilt binaries Posit Package Manager, builds fast need compiler toolchain run time. Posit Package Manager serves amd64 (x86_64) Linux binaries, Apple Silicon machine build production target explicitly — otherwise native arm64 build compiles every dependency source: aurora_dockerfile() writes Dockerfile whose entry point Rscript api.R, container local development share one assembly path. Key arguments: flavor — "debian" (default) "alpine" (see ). base — base image; NULL resolves per flavor (rocker/r-ver / rhub/r-minimal). sysdeps — "auto" uses curated default set covering plumber2 + bslib baseline plus common TLS/curl/db/geo/graphics needs; pass vector override. port — exposed port (default 8000).
code: library(aurora)  aurora_build_ui("meu_app")   # compile www/index.html (needs bslib; run on dev/CI)  # Generate a Dockerfile (+ .dockerignore). It installs only the runtime deps # your routers/helpers need, plus plumber2 and aurora. aurora_dockerfile("meu_app")  # Build (and optionally push) the image using the docker CLI. aurora_build_image("meu_app", tag = "org/meu_app:latest", push = TRUE) docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t org/meu_app:latest .

title: Deploying aurora apps
text: alpine flavor compiles everything (CRAN binaries Alpine) uses installr -d -t "<build deps>" -"<runtime libs>". aurora ships defaults cover plumber2 + bslib baseline; extra system libraries (e.g. GDAL/GEOS sf) pass via sysdeps. Note aurora’s baseline still pulls non-trivial tree (httpuv, fiery stack, roxygen2, graphics packages), even small app compiles fair amount Alpine — win final image size.
code: aurora_dockerfile("meu_app", flavor = "alpine")

title: Telemetry with OpenTelemetry
text: instrumentation lives layers plumber2 (reqres, fiery, routr), works moment OpenTelemetry enabled environment: span per request, attached request object (request$otel) closed automatically response sent. carries standard HTTP attributes plus server.id, server.framework.name ("plumber2"), server.framework.version. subspan per route request passes , routr.route routr.path.param.<name> attributes. standard server metrics: http.server.request.duration, http.server.active_requests, http.server.request.body.size, http.server.response.body.size.

title: Telemetry with OpenTelemetry
text: aurora wires plumber2::api_logger(plumber2::logger_otel()) logs join spans metrics. Enable three ways (highest precedence first): flag resolves : explicit otel = argument > _aurora.yml otel: > AURORA_OTEL env var > FALSE (). Leaving safe: wiring otel logger -op OpenTelemetry actually enabled environment (see ). can bake otel: true production image control collection purely env vars.
code: # 1. Explicitly at run time aurora_run("meu_app", otel = TRUE)  # 2. In the optional manifest — _aurora.yml # otel: true  # 3. Via environment (handy for containers; the generated api.R reads it) Sys.setenv(AURORA_OTEL = "true") aurora_run("meu_app")

title: Telemetry with OpenTelemetry
text: aurora exporter configuration — belongs otel otelsdk packages, driven standard OTEL_* environment variables. essentials: Install otel (instrumentation API) otelsdk (collector/exporter). Select exporters OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER, OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER (OTEL_R_* variants). none set, nothing emitted — exactly makes aurora flag safe -op. Use OTEL_ENV=dev developing telemetry code fails loudly instead swallowing errors. Consult otel/otelsdk package docs full list pointing exporter collector (e.g. OTLP endpoint). aurora intentionally wrap .

what: Custom spans and logs in your handlers
title: Telemetry with OpenTelemetry
text: Inside route handler can add spans; automatically pick active routr subspan parent: Two aurora conventions worth following: Log server$log(...) (reserved server handler argument) rather cat()/print(), logs picked otel logger associated request span. Keep custom instrumentation sparse — default instrumentation already detailed. Add spans operations specifically care .
code: #* @get /api/report/<id> #* @serializer json function(id, server) {   otel::start_local_active_span("build report")   # closes at end of scope   server$log("message", paste("building report", id))   # joins the request span   build_report(id) }

code: aurora_dockerfile(   dir = ".",   flavor = c("debian", "alpine"),   base = NULL,   sysdeps = "auto",   port = 8000L,   aurora_source = "aurora-govpe/aurora-rpkg@v0.1.3",   tz = "America/Recife",   locale = "C.UTF-8",   write = TRUE )

title: Generate a Dockerfile (and .dockerignore) for an aurora app — aurora_dockerfile
text: dir App directory. flavor Base-image flavor: "debian" (rocker + PPM binaries) "alpine" (r-minimal + source builds). base Base Docker image. NULL (default) resolves per flavor: rocker/r-ver:4.4.1 (debian) rhub/r-minimal (alpine). sysdeps "auto" uses curated default set system packages flavor (covers plumber2 + bslib baseline plus common TLS/curl/db/geo/ graphics needs); pass character vector set explicitly. "alpine" build (-t) set; runtime libs use curated default. (pkg_sysreqs() auto-resolution proved unreliable, aurora ships comprehensive defaults instead – extra -dev packages build-time .) port Port exposed bound (via AURORA_PORT env var). aurora_source pak/remotes spec used install aurora image. Defaults pinned release "aurora-govpe/aurora-rpkg@v0.1.3" reproducible builds. Avoid unpinned moving ref (branch): interacts badly Docker's layer cache, can silently keep old commit rebuild. Bump default (pass explicit @tag) per release. tz Timezone baked image ENV TZ= (set R starts, applies system logs, R's date-times, DB drivers). Defaults "America/Recife"; pass NULL ("") omit line. "alpine" image also gets tzdata TZDIR zone actually resolves. locale Locale baked ENV LANG=/LC_ALL=. Defaults "C.UTF-8" (UTF-8, available everywhere). specific locale like "pt_BR.UTF-8" needs matching locale image: "debian" (glibc) present; "alpine" aurora adds musl-locales/musl-locales-lang packages works – though musl's locale support partial (charset messages apply, collation falls back C). write Write file (TRUE) return text (FALSE).

title: Generate a Dockerfile (and .dockerignore) for an aurora app — aurora_dockerfile
text: Two flavors: "debian" (default) – rocker/r-ver; installs R packages binaries Posit Package Manager (fast builds; amd64). Best heavy/geo apps fast CI. Larger image. "alpine" – rhub/r-minimal; tiny image (~25 MB base) compiles every package source via installr (CRAN binaries; builds slower). Best image size matters need native arm64. Tune Alpine build/runtime system deps via sysdeps packages need . Runtime R packages detected scanning routers/, helpers/, api.R. pin explicitly (reproducible images), set packages: list _aurora.yml; plumber2 aurora always added.

text: dir App directory (canonical aurora layout). port Port bind. host Host/interface bind. rebuild_ui Whether rebuild static UI running. NULL (default) resolves AURORA_REBUILD_UI environment variable (default TRUE locally). Containers set FALSE: UI compiled build time shipped www/index.html, runtime image serves without UI build dependencies (bslib, transitively shiny). watch Live-reload development. TRUE, aurora polls UI source files (build_ui.R ui_modules/) rebuilds static www/index.html change – refresh browser see . Changes routers//helpers/ detected hot-swapped running server, log advisory restart. Requires later package. watch_interval Polling interval seconds watch = TRUE. otel Enable OpenTelemetry logging. Passed aurora_app(); NULL (default) resolves _aurora.yml AURORA_OTEL env var. verbose Per-step cli logging. Passed aurora_app(); NULL (default) resolves options(aurora.verbose) AURORA_VERBOSE. attach Attach _aurora.yml packages: sourcing helpers. Passed aurora_app(); NULL (default) resolves _aurora.yml (attach:) AURORA_ATTACH. See ADR-012. on_exit Optional cleanup function function() run server stops (registered plumber2's "cleanup" lifecycle event). Use release resources opened helper – e.g. pool::poolClose(con_base) – replacing v1 pr_hook("exit", ...). Errors handler reported block shutdown.
